Subject: Stakeholder alignment & steering readiness — proposed panel dates and artifacts

Thanks again for a productive discovery today, Alex and Dana — good conversation and clear priorities.  Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum:  

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time personalized recommendations in checkout (latency <150ms p95) and embeddings for product search relevance.
- Top success criteria: latency SLO, predictable per-token cost, and clear data residency controls for EU customers.
- Timeline: proof-of-concept (PoC) in 6–8 weeks, steering/exec decision at the end of the PoC.

Stakeholder ask (please confirm names/roles):
1) Economic buyer: who will sign/own the PO and commercial terms?
2) Security/compliance lead: who will validate SOC2/PEN test and network controls?
3) Procurement contact: PO/contract routing, standard T&C redlines.

Proposed steering panel (one-hour):
- 20m exec sponsor briefing (high-level risks & ROI)
- 30m technical alignment (security, deployment, timeline)
- 10m decision checkpoints & next steps

Proposed dates (Pacific time):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 22, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Mon Apr 26, 09:00–10:00 PT

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan), deploy_outline.docx (high-level infra and integration notes).  
Please reply with: 1) confirmed exec sponsor and security/procurement contacts, and 2) preferred steering date.  Happy to adjust for Dana's schedule.

Best,
Jordan Blake
